TpsSaleTransaction.description: TPS record semantics from the publisher dictionary, with exact JSON wire names/string representation corroborated by three saved records. Numeric dictionary quantities are string-encoded in those observations; no closed field set or universal requiredness is inferred.

assignment_date.description: Assignment date in dd-mm-yyyy format. Publisher label: Assignment Date; declared type: Date. Exact JSON key and string representation observed in three saved records; this observation does not establish universal requiredness or exhaustive keys.

credit_level.description: Credit level of credit. English values documented: F = Full credit, H = Half credit, 0 = Zero credit. Traditional Chinese values documented: 全 = full, 半 = half, 0 = zero. Publisher label: Credit Level; declared type: Text. Exact JSON key and string representation observed in three saved records; this observation does not establish universal requiredness or exhaustive keys.

externalDocs.description: Official TPS sale transactions data specification, version 1.3 (25 July 2024). Dataset page: https://data.gov.hk/en-data/dataset/hk-housing-tpssale-tpssale

info.description: Returns Tenants Purchase Scheme (TPS) sale transaction data in JSON. The source documents version 1.3, dated 25 July 2024; this is the documentation version, not necessarily an API version. Authentication is explicitly not required. Response field information is incomplete and its table layout is ambiguous, so response schemas are permissive and do not assert an exhaustive field set. The retained dictionary is supplemented by one explicitly observed JSON prefix containing three records; wire names and representation are observational rather than publisher-guaranteed.
info.title: Tenants Purchase Scheme Sale Transactions API

get.description: Returns sales transaction data for the Tenants Purchase Scheme in JSON. The documented resource URL is printed with a malformed single slash after `https:`; the example request and documented hostname establish the HTTPS server base used here.

parameters.description: Data resource identifier. The documented valid value is `tps_sale_transactions` for Tenants Purchase Scheme (TPS) Sale Transactions.
parameters.name: dataresource

parameters.description: Response file format. JSON is the documented valid format.
parameters.name: format

schema.description: Object/data-array envelope observed in a bounded stream sample; unread suffix and later records were not validated. Additional fields remain allowed.

200.description: Success. UTF-8 JSON response. The source describes transaction fields but does not provide a reliable wire-level JSON example or an unambiguous complete response structure.
